item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #VISPRSD
Issued at 03:51 PM 28 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Leyte(Babatngon, SanMiguel, Kananga, OrmocCity) and #Samar(Talalora) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Leyte(Barugo, Tunga, Jaro, Carigara), #Samar(Villareal and SantaRita) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
